1.1: Kol hammenachot shennikmetzu shello lishman, kesherot, ella shello alu labbealim mishshum chova, chutz mimminchat chote, uminchat kenaot. minchat chote uminchat kenaot shekkematzan shello lishman, natan bakkeli, vehillech, vehiktir shello lishman, o lishman veshello lishman, o shello lishman velishman, pesulot. ketzad lishman veshello lishman, leshem minchat chote uleshem minchat nedava, o shello lishman velishman, leshem minchat nedava uleshem minchat chote:
1.2: Achat minchat chote veachat kol hammenachot shekkematzan zar, onen, tevul yom, mechussar begadim, mechussar kippurim, shello rechutz yadayim veraglayim, arel, tame, yoshev, omed al gabbe chelim, al gabbe vehema, al gabbe ragle chavero, pasal. kamatz bismol, pasal. ben betera omer, yachazir veyachazor veyikmotz beyamin. kamatz veala veyado tzeror o gargir melach o koret shel levona, pasal, mippene sheamru, hakkometz hayyater vehechaser, pasul. eze hu hayyater, shekkematzo mevoratz. vechaser, shekkematzo verashe etzbeotav. ketzad hu ose, poshet et etzbeotav al pas yado:
1.3: Ribba shamnah, vechissar shamnah, chissar levonatah, pesula. hakkometz et hammincha leechol sheyareha vachutz, o chazzayit mishsheyareha vachutz, lehaketir kumtzah bachutz, o chazzayit mikkumtzah bachutz, o lehaketir levonatah bachutz, pasul veen bo charet. leechol sheyareha lemachar, o chazzayit mishsheyareha lemachar, lehaketir kumtzah lemachar, o chazzayit mikkumtzah lemachar, o lehaketir levonatah lemachar, piggul vechayyavin alav karet. ze hakkelal, kol hakkometz, vehannoten bichli, vehamehallech, vehammaktir, leechol davar sheddarko leechol, ulehaktir davar sheddarko lehaketir, chutz limkomo, pasul veen bo charet. chutz lizmanno, piggul vechayyavin alav karet, uvilvad sheyyikrav hammattir kemitzvato. ketzad karav hammattir kemitzvato. kamatz bishtika venatan bakkeli vehillech vehiktir chutz lizmanno, o shekkamatz chutz lizmanno venatan bakkeli vehillech vehiktir bishtika, o shekkamatz venatan bakkeli vehillech vehiktir chutz lizmanno, ze hu shekkarav hammattir kemitzvato:
1.4: Ketzad lo karav hammattir kemitzvato. kamatz chutz limkomo, venatan bakkeli vehillech vehiktir chutz lizmanno, o shekkamatz chutz lizmanno venatan bakkeli vehillech vehiktir chutz limkomo, o shekkamatz venatan bakkeli vehillech vehiktir chutz limkomo, minchat chote uminchat kenaot shekkematzan shello lishman venatan bakkeli vehillech vehiktir chutz lizmannan, o shekkamatz chutz lizmannan, venatan bakkeli vehillech vehiktir shello lishman, o shekkamatz venatan bakkeli vehillech vehiktir shello lishman, ze hu shello karav hammattir kemitzvato. leechol kazzayit bachutz vechazzayit lemachar, kazzayit lemachar vechazzayit bachutz, kachatzi zayit bachutz vechachatzi zayit lemachar, kachatzi zayit lemachar vechachatzi zayit bachutz, pasul veen bo charet. amar rabbi yehuda, ze hakkelal, im machashevet hazzeman kadma lemachashevet hammakom, piggul vechayyavim alav karet. veim machashevet hammakom kadma lemachashevet hazzeman, pasul veen bo charet. vachachamim omrim, ze vaze pasul veen bo charet. leechol kachatzi zayit ulehaktir kachatzi zayit, kasher, sheen achila vehaketara mitztarfin:

2.1: Hakkometz et hammincha leechol sheyareha o lehaketir kumtzah lemachar, mode rabbi yose baze, shehu figgul vechayyavin alav karet. lehaketir levonatah lemachar, rabbi yose omer, pasul veen bo charet, vachachamim omrim, pigul vechayyavin alav karet. amru lo, ma shana zo min hazzavach. amar lahem, shehazzevach damo uvesaro veemurav echad, ulevona enah min hammincha:
2.2: Shachat shene chevasim leechol achat min hachallot lemachar, hiktir shene vezichin leechol achad min hassedarim lemachar, rabbi yose omer, otah hachalla veoto hasseder shechishshav alav, piggul vechayyavin alav karet, vehashsheni pasul veen bo charet. vachachamim omrim, ze vaze piggul vechayyavin alav karet. nitmet achat min hachallot o achad min hassedarim, rabbi yehuda omer, shenehem yetzu levet hasserefa, sheen karban tzibbur chaluk. vachachamim omrim, hattame vetumato, vehattahor yeachel:
2.3: Hattoda mefaggelet et hallechem, vehallechem eno mefaggel et hattoda. ketzad. hashshochet et hattoda leechol mimmenna lemachar, hi vehallechem mefuggalin. leechol min hallechem lemachar, hallechem mefuggal vehattoda enah mefuggalet. hakkevasim mefaggelin et hallechem, vehallechem eno mefaggel et hakkevasim. ketzad. hashshochet et hakkevasim leechol mehem lemachar, hem vehallechem mefuggalim. leechol min hallechem lemachar, hallechem mefuggal, vehakkevasim enan mefuggalin:
2.4: Hazzevach mefaggel et hannesachin mishshekkadshu vichli, divre rabbi meir. vehannesachin enan mefaggelin et hazzavach. ketzad. hashshochet et hazzevach leechol mimmennu lemachar, hu unesachav mefuggalin. lehakeriv min hannesachin lemachar, hannesachin mefuggalin, vehazzevach eno mefuggal:
2.5: Piggel bakkometz velo vallevona, ballevona velo vakkometz, rabbi meir omer, piggul vechayyavin alav karet. vachachamim omrim, en bo charet, ad sheyyefaggel et kol hammattir. modim chachamim lerabbi meir beminchat chote uveminchat kenaot, sheim piggel bakkometz, shehu figgul vechayyavin alav karet, shehakkometz hu hammattir. shachat achad min hakkevasim leechol shete challot lemachar, hiktir achad min habbezichim leechol shene sedarim lemachar, rabbi meir omer, piggul vechayyavim alav karet. vachachamim omrim, en piggul, ad sheyyefaggel et kol hammattir. shachat achad min hakkevasim leechol mimmennu lemachar, hu figgul, vachavero chasher. leechol mechavero lemachar, shenehem kesherim:

3.1: Hakkometz et hammincha leechol davar sheen darko leechol, lehaketir davar sheen darko lehaketir, kasher. rabbi eliezer posel. leechol davar sheddarko leechol, lehaketir davar sheddarko lehaketir, pachot mikkazzayit, kasher. leechol kachatzi zayit ulehaktir kachatzi zayit, kasher, sheen achila vehaketara mitztarfin:
3.2: Lo yatzak, lo valal, lo fatat, lo malach, lo henif, lo higgish, o sheppetatan pittim merubbot, velo meshachan, kesherot. nitarev kumtzah bekometz chavertah, beminchat kohanim, beminchat kohen hammashiach, beminchat nesachin, keshera. rabbi yehuda omer, beminchat kohen hammashiach uveminchat nesachin, pesula, shezzo belilatah ava, vezo belilatah rakka, vehen bolot zo mizzo:
3.3: Shete menachot shello nikmetzu, venitarvu zo vazo, im yachol likmotz mizzo bifne atzmah umizzo bifne atzmah, kesherot. veim lav, pesulot. hakkometz shennitarev bemincha shello nikmetza, lo yaktir. veim hiktir, zo shennikmetza, alta labbealim, vezo shello nikmetza, lo alta labbealim. nitarev kumtzah bishyareha o vishyareha shel chavertah, lo yaktir. veim hiktir, alta labbealim. nitma hakkometz vehikrivo, hatztzitz meratztze. yatza vehikrivo, en hatztzitz meratztze, shehatztzitz meratztze al hattame, veeno meratztze al hayyotze:
3.4: Nitmeu sheyareha, nisrefu sheyareha, avdu sheyareha, kemiddat rabbi eliezer, keshera. uchemiddat rabbi yehoshua, pesula. shello vichli sharet, pesula. rabbi shimon machshir. hiktir kumtzah paamayim, keshera:
3.5: Hakkometz, miuto meakkev et rubbo. haissaron, miuto meakkev et rubbo. hayyayin, miuto meakkev et rubbo. hashshemen, miuto meakkev et rubbo. hassolet vehashshemen meakkevin ze et ze. hakkometz vehallevona meakkevin ze et ze:
3.6: Shene seire yom hakkippurim meakkevin ze et ze. shene chivse atzeret meakkevin ze et ze. shete challot meakkevot zo et zo. shene sedarim meakkevin ze et ze. shene vezichin meakkevin ze et ze. hassedarim vehabbezichin meakkevin ze et ze. shene minim shebbannazir, shelosha shebbappara, arbaa shebbattoda, arbaa shebballulav, arbaa shebbammetzora, meakkevin ze et ze. sheva hazzayot shebbappara meakkevot zo et zo. sheva hazzayot shel ben habbaddim, vesheal happarochet, vesheal mizbach hazzahav, meakkevot zo et zo:
3.7: Shiva kene menora meakkevin ze et ze. shiva neroteha meakkevin ze et ze. shete farashiyyot shebbammezuza meakkevot zo et zo. vaafillu chetav echad meakkevan. arba parashiyyot shebbattefillin meakkevot zo et zo. vaafillu chetav echad meakkevan. arba tzitziyyot meakkevot zo et zo, shearbatan mitzva echat. rabbi yishmael omer, arbatan arba mitzvot:

4.1: Hattechelet enah meakkevet et hallavan, vehallavan eno meakkev et hattechelet. tefilla shel yad enah meakkevet shel rosh, veshel rosh enah meakkevet shel yad. hassolet vehashshemen enam meakkevin et hayyayin, velo hayyayin meakkevan. hammattanot sheal mizbeach hachitzon enan meakkevot zo et zo:
4.2: Happarim vehaelim vehakkevasim enan meakkevin ze et ze. rabbi shimon omer, im hayu lahem parim merubbim velo hayu lahem nesachim, yaviu far echad unesachav, velo yikrevu chullan belo nesachin:
4.3: Happar vehaelim vehakkevasim vehassair enan meakkevin et hallechem, velo hallechem meakkevan. hallechem meakkev et hakkevasim, vehakkevasim enan meakkevin et hallechem, divre rabbi akiva. amar shimon ben nannas, lo chi, ella hakkevasim meakkevin et hallechem, vehallechem eno meakkev et hakkevasim, shekken matzinu, keshehayu yisrael bammidbar arbaim shana, karvu chevasim belo lechem, af kan yikrevu chevasim belo lachem. amar rabbi shimon, halacha kedivre ven nannas, aval en hattaam kidvarav, shekkol haamur bechummash happekudim, karav bammidbar. vechol haamur betorat kohanim, lo karav bammidbar. mishshebbau laaretz, karvu ellu vaellu. umippene ma ani omer yikrevu chevasim belo lechem, shehakkevasim mattirin et atzman belo lechem. lechem belo chevasim, en li mi yattirennu:
4.4: Hattemidin enan meakkevin et hammusafim, velo hammusafim meakkevin et hattemidim, velo hammusafim meakkevin ze et ze. lo hikrivu cheves babboker, yakrivu ben haarbayim. amar rabbi shimon, ematay, bizman shehayu anusin o shoggin. aval im hayu mezidin velo hikrivu cheves babboker, lo yakrivu ben haarbayim. lo hiktiru ketoret babboker, yaktiru ben haarbayim. amar rabbi shimon, vechullah hayta kereva ben haarbayim, sheen mechannechin et mizbach hazzahav ella viktoret hassammim, velo mizbach haola ella vetamid shel shachar, velo et hashshulchan ella velechem happanim beshabbat, velo et hammenora ella veshiva neroteha ben haarbayim:
4.5: Chavitte chohen gadol, lo hayu vaot chatzayim, ella mevi issaron shalem, vechotzehu, umakriv mechetza vabboker, umechetza ven haarbayim. vechohen shehikriv mechetza beshacharit umet uminnu chohen acher tachtav, lo yavi chatzi issaron mibbeto, velo chatzi esrono shel rishon, ella mevi issaron shalem, vechotzehu, umakriv mechetza, umechetza aved. nimtzeu shene chatzayim kerevin, ushene chatzayim ovdin. lo minnu chohen acher, mishshel mi hayta kereva. rabbi shimon omer, mishshel tzibbur. rabbi yehuda omer, mishshel yorshim. ushelema hayta kereva:

5.1: Kol hammenachot baot matztza, chutz mechametz shebbattoda ushete hallechem, shehen baot chametz. rabbi meir omer, seor bode lahen mittochan umechammetzan. rabbi yehuda omer, af hi enah min hammuvchar, ella mevi et hasseor, venoten letoch hammidda, umemalle et hammidda. amru lo, af hi hayta chasera o yetera:
5.2: Kol hammenachot nilloshot befoshrin, umeshammeran shello yachamitzu. veim hechemitzu sheyareha, over belo taase, shenneemar (Vayikra b), kol hammincha asher takrivu laAdonai lo tease chametz. vechayyavim al lishatah, veal arichatah, veal afiyyatah:
5.3: Yesh teunot shemen ulevona, shemen velo levona, levona velo shemen, lo shemen velo levona. veellu teunot shemen ulevona, minchat hassolet, vehammachavat, vehammarcheshet, vehachallot, veharkikin, minchat kohanim, uminchat kohen mashiach, uminchat goyim, uminchat nashim, uminchat haomer. minchat nesachin teuna shemen, veen teuna levona. lechem happanim taun levona, veen taun shamen. shete hallechem, minchat chote uminchat kenaot, lo shemen velo levona:
5.4: Vechayyav al hashshemen bifne atzmo, veal hallevona bifne atzmah. natan aleha shemen, pesalah. levona, yilketenna. natan shemen al sheyareha, eno over belo taase. natan keli al gabbe keli, lo fesalah:
5.5: Yesh teunot haggasha veenan teunot tenufa, tenufa velo haggasha, haggasha utenufa, lo tenufa velo haggasha. ellu teunot haggasha veenan teunot tenufa, minchat hassolet, vehammachavat, vehammarcheshet, vehachallot, veharkikin, minchat kohanim, minchat kohen mashiach, minchat goyim, minchat nashim, minchat chote. rabbi shimon omer, minchat kohanim, minchat kohen mashiach, en bahen haggasha, mifne sheen bahen kemitza. vechol sheen bahen kemitza, en bahen haggasha:
5.6: Ellu teunin tenufa veen teunin haggasha, log shemen shel metzora vaashamo, vehabbikkurim kedivre rabbi eliezer ben yaakov, veemure shalme yachid vechaze vashok shellahen, echad anashim, veechad nashim, beyisrael aval lo vaacherim, ushete hallechem, ushene chivse atzaret. ketzad hu ose, noten shete hallechem al gabbe shene chevasim, umanniach shete yadav millemattan, molich umevi, maale umorid, shenneemar (Shemot 29), asher hunaf vaasher huram. tenufa hayta vammizrach, vehaggasha bammaarav. utenufot kodmot lehaggashot. minchat haomer uminchat kenaot, teunot tenufa vehaggasha. lechem happanim uminchat nesachim, lo tenufa velo haggasha:
5.7: Rabbi shimon omer, shelosha minim teunim shalosh mitzvot, shetayim bechol achat veachat, vehashshelishit en bahen. veellu hen, zivche shalme yachid, vezivche shalme tzibbur, vaasham metzora. zivche shalme yachid, teunim semicha chayyim, utenufa shechutim, veen bahem tenufa chayyim. zivche shalme tzibbur, teunim tenufa chayyim ushechutim, veen bahen semicha. vaasham metzora, taun semicha utenufa chay, veen bo tenufa shachut:
5.8: Haomer hare alay bemachavat, lo yavi vemarcheshet. bemarcheshet, lo yavi vemachavat. uma ben machavat lemarcheshet, ella shehammarcheshet yesh lah kissuy, vehammachavat en lah kissuy, divre rabbi yose haggelili. rabbi chananya ven gamliel omer, marcheshet amukka umaaseha rochashim, umachavat tzafa umaaseha kashim:
5.9: Haomer hare alay battannur, lo yavi maafe chuppach umaafe reafim umaafe yorot haarviyyim. rabbi yehuda omer, im ratza, yavi maafe chuppach. hare alay minchat maafe, lo yavi mechetza challot umechetza rekikin. rabbi shimon mattir, mippene shehu karban echad:

6.1: Ellu menachot nikmatzot usheyarehen lakkohanim, minchat solet, vehammachavat, vehammarcheshet, vehachallot, veharkikin, minchat goyim, minchat nashim, minchat haomer, minchat chote, uminchat kenaot. rabbi shimon omer, minchat chote shel kohanim nikmetzet, vehakkometz karev leatzmo, vehashshirayim kerevin leatzman:
6.2: Minchat kohanim uminchat kohen mashiach uminchat nesachim, lammizbeach, veen bahem lakkohanim. baze yafe choach hammizbeach mikkoach hakkohanim. shete hallechem velechem happanim, lakkohanim, veen bahem lammizbeach. uvaze yafe choach hakkohanim mikkoach hammizbeach:
6.3: Kol hammenachot hannaasot bichli teunot shalosh mattenot shemen, yetzika, uvelila, umattan shemen bakkeli kodem laasiyyatan. vehachallot bollan, divre rabbi. vachachamim omrim, solet. hachallot teunot belila, harkikim meshuchin. ketzad moshchan, kemin chi. ushear hashshemen neechol lakkohanim:
6.4: Kol hammenachot hannaasot bichli, teunot petita. minchat yisrael, kofel echad lishnayim, ushenayim learbaa, umavdil. minchat kohanim, kofel echad lishnayim, ushenayim learbaa, veeno mavdil. minchat kohen hammashiach, lo haya mechappelah. rabbi shimon omer, minchat kohanim uminchat kohen mashiach, en bahem petita, mippene sheen bahem kemitza, vechol sheen bahem kemitza, en bahen petita. vechullan kazzetim:
6.5: Kol hammenachot teunot shelosh meot shifa vachamesh meot beita. vehashshifa vehabbeita bachittim. rabbi yose omer, af babbatzek. kol hammenachot baot eser eser, chutz millechem happanim, vachavitte chohen gadol, shehem baot shetem esre, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi meir omer, kullan baot shetem esre, chutz mechallot toda vehannezirut, shehen baot eser eser:
6.6: Haomer haya va issaron mishshalosh sein. shete hallechem, shene esronim mishshalosh sein. lechem happanim, esrim vearbaa esronim meesrim vearba sein:
6.7: Haomer haya menuppe bishlosh esre nafa. ushete hallechem bishtem esre. velechem happanim beachat esre. rabbi shimon omer, lo haya lah kitzba, ella solet menuppa kol tzarkah haya mevi, shenneemar (Vayikra kad), velakachta solet veafita otah, ad shettehe menuppa kol tzarkah:

7.1: Hattoda hayta vaa chamesh sein yerushalmiyyot, shehen shesh midbariyyot, shete efot, haefa shalosh sein, esrim issaron, asara lechametz vaasara lammatztza. asara lechametz, issaron lechalla. vaasara lammatztza, uvammatztza shelosha minin, challot urekikim urevucha. nimtzeu shelosha esronot ushelish lechol min, shalosh challot leissaron. bemidda yerushalmit hayu sheloshim kav, chamishsha asar lechametz, vachamishsha asar lammatztza. chamishsha asar lechametz, kav vachetzi lechalla. vachamishsha asar lammatztza, vehammatztza shelosha minin, challot urekikim urevucha, nimtzeu chameshet kabbim lechol min, shete challot lekav:
7.2: Hammilluim hayu vaim kammatztza shebbattoda, challot urekikim urevucha. hannezirut hayta vaa shete yadot bammatztza shebbattoda, challot urekikim, veen bah revucha, nimtzeu asara kabbim yerushalmiyyot, shehen shishsha esronot vaaduyan. umikkullan haya notel echad measara teruma, shenneemar (Vayikra 7), vehikriv mimmennu echad mikkol karban teruma laAdonai. echad, shello yittol parus. mikkol karban, sheyyehu chol hakkarbanot shavin, veshello yittol mikkarban lachavero. lakkohen hazzorek et dam hashshelamim lo yihye, vehashshear neechol labbealim:
7.3: Hashshochet et hattoda bifnim, velachmah chutz lachoma, lo kadash hallachem. shechatah ad shello karmu vattannur, vaafillu karmu chullan chutz meachad mehen, lo kadash hallachem. shechatah chutz lizmannah vechutz limkomah, kadash hallachem. shechatah venimtzet terefa, lo kadash hallachem. shechatah venimtzet baalat mum, rabbi eliezer omer, kadash, vachachamim omrim, lo kadash. shechatah shello lishmah, vechen el hammiluim vechen shene chivse atzeret sheshshechatan shello lishman, lo kadash hallachem:
7.4: Nesachin shekkadshu vichli venimtza hazzevach pasul, im yesh sham zevach acher, yikrevu immo. veim lav, yippaslu velina. velad toda utemuratah, vehammafrish todato veavda vehifrish acheret tachteha, enan teunim lechem, shenneemar (Vayikra 7), vehikriv al zevach hattoda, hattoda teuna lechem, velo veladah velo chalifatah velo temuratah teunin lachem:
7.5: Haomer hare alay toda, yavi hi velachmah min hachullin. toda min hachullin velachmah min hammaaser, yavi hi velachmah min hachullin. toda min hammaaser velachmah min hachullin, yavi. hattoda hi velachmah min hammaaser, yavi. velo yavi mechitte maaser sheni, ella mimmeot maaser sheni:
7.6: Minnayin laomer hare alay toda, lo yavi ella min hachullin, shenneemar (Devarim 16), vezavachta pesach laAdonai elohecha tzon uvakar, vahalo en pesach ba ella min hakkevasim umin haizzim. im ken, lamma neemar tzon uvakar. ella lehakish kol habba min habbakar umin hatztzon lappesach, ma happesach, shehu va vechova, eno va ella min hachullin, af kol davar shehu va vechova, lo yavo ella min hachullin. lefichach, haomer hare alay toda, hare alay shelamim, hoil vehem baim chova, lo yavou ella min hachullin. vehannesachim bechol makom lo yavou ella min hachullin:

8.1: Kol karbenot hatztzibbur vehayyachid baim min haaretz umichutza laaretz, min hechadash umin hayyashan, chutz min haomer ushete hallechem, sheenan baim ella min hechadash umin haaretz. vechullan enan baim ella min hammuvchar. veezehu muvchar. michmas umezonicha, alfa lassolet. sheniyya lahem, chafarayim babbika. kol haaratzot hayu chesherot, ella mikkan hayu meviim:
8.2: En meviin lo mibbet hazzevalim, velo mibbet hashshelachim, velo mibbet hailan. veim hevi, kasher. ketzad hu ose, narah shana rishona, uvashsheniyya zorah kodem lappesach shivim yom, vehi osa solet merubba. ketzad hu vodek. haggizbar machnis et yado letochah. ala vah avak, pesula, ad sheyyenifenna. veim hitlia, pesula:
8.3: Tekoa, alfa lashshamen. abba shaul omer, sheniyya lah regev beever hayyarden. kol haaratzot hayu chesherot, ella mikkan hayu meviin. en meviin lo mibbet hazzevalim, velo mibbet hashshelachim, velo mimma shennizra benehem. veim hevi, kasher. en meviin anpiknon. veim hevi, pasul. en meviin min haggargerim shennishru vammayim, velo min hakkevushim, velo min hashshelukin. veim hevi, pasul:
8.4: Shelosha zetim, uvahen shelosha shelosha shemanim. hazzayit harishon, megargero verosh hazzayit vechotesh venoten letoch hassal. rabbi yehuda omer, sevivot hassal. ze rishon. taan bekora, rabbi yehuda omer, baavanim. ze sheni. chazar vetachan vetaan, ze shelishi. harishon lammenora, vehashshear lammenachot. hazzayit hashsheni megargero verosh haggag, vechotesh venoten letoch hassal. rabbi yehuda omer, sevivot hassal, ze rishon. taan bekora, rabbi yehuda omer, baavanim, ze sheni. chazar vetachan vetaan, ze shelishi. harishon lammenora, vehashshear lammenachot. hazzayit hashshelishi, otno vetoch habbayit ad sheyyilke, umaalehu umenaggevo verosh haggag, vechotesh venoten letoch hassal. rabbi yehuda omer, sevivot hassal, ze rishon. taan bekora, rabbi yehuda omer, baavanim, ze sheni. chazar vetachan vetaan, ze shelishi. harishon lammenora, vehashshear lammenachot:
8.5: Harishon shebbarishon, en lemala mimmennu. hashsheni shebbarishon veharishon shebbashsheni, shavin. hashshelishi shebbarishon vehashsheni shebbashsheni veharishon shebbashshelishi, shavin. hashshelishi shebbashsheni vehashsheni shebbashshelishi, shavin. hashshelishi shebbashshelishi, en lematta mimmennu. af hammenachot hayu vaddin sheyyittaanu shemen zayit zach. ma im hammenora sheenah laachila, teuna shemen zayit zach, hammenachot, shehen laachila, eno din sheyyittaanu shemen zayit zach. talmud lomar (Shemot 27), zach katit lammaor, velo zach katit lammenachot:
8.6: Uminnayin hayu meviin et hayyayin. kerutim vehattulim, alfa layyayin. sheniyya lahen, bet rimma uvet lavan bahar, uchefar signa vabbika. kol haaratzot hayu chesherot, ella mikkan hayu meviin. en meviin, lo mibbet hazzevalim, velo mibbet hashshelachin, velo mimma shennizra benehen. veim hevi, kasher. en meviin ilyusetan. veim hevi, kasher. en meviin yashan, divre rabbi. vachachamim machshirin. en meviin, lo matok, velo meushshan, velo mevushshal. veim hevi, pasul. en meviin min haddaliyyot, ella min harogliyyot umin hakkeramim haavudim:
8.7: Lo hayu chonsim oto vachatzavim gedolim, ella vechaviyyot ketannot. veeno memalle et hechaviyyot ad pihem, kede sheyyehe recho nodef. eno mevi, lo mippiha, mippene hakkemachin. velo mishshuleha, mippene hashshemarim. ella mevi mishshelishah umeemtzaah. ketzad hu vodek, haggizbar yoshev vehakkane veyado, zarak et haggid vehikkish bakkane. rabbi yose verabbi yehuda omer, yayin sheala vo kemachin, pasul, shenneemar, temimim yihyu lachem uminchatam (Bamidbar 28), temimim yihyu lachem veniskehem (sham):

9.1: Shete middot shel yavesh hayu vammikdash, issaron, vachatzi issaron. rabbi meir omer, issaron, issaron, vachatzi issaron. issaron me haya meshammesh, shebbo haya moded lechol hammenachot. lo haya moded, lo veshel shelosha lefar, velo veshel shenayim leayil, ella moddan esronot. chatzi issaron me haya meshammesh, shebbo haya moded chavitte chohen gadol, mechetza babboker umechetza ben haarbayim:
9.2: Sheva middot shel lach hayu vammikdash. hin, vachatzi hahin, ushelishit hahin, ureviit hahin, log, vachatzi log, ureviit log. rabbi eliezer bar tzadok omer, shenatot hayu vahin, ad kan lefar, ad kan leayil, ad kan lecheves. rabbi shimon omer, lo haya sham hin, vechi me haya hahin meshammesh. ella midda yetera shel log umechetza hayta, shebbah haya moded leminchat kohen gadol, log umechetza babboker velog umechetza ben haarbayim:
9.3: Reviit me hayta meshammeshet. reviit mayim limtzora, ureviit shemen lenazir. chatzi log me haya meshammesh. chatzi log mayim lesota. vachatzi log shemen letoda. uvallog haya moded lechol hammenachot. afillu mincha shel shishshim issaron, noten lah shishshim log. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, afillu mincha shel shishshim issaron, en lah ella luggah, shenneemar (Vayikra 14), lemincha velog shamen. shishsha lefar, arbaa leayil, shelosha lecheves, shelosha umechetza lammenora, mechatzi log lechol ner:
9.4: Mearvin niske elim beniske farim, niske chevasim beniske chevasim, shel yachid beshel tzibbur, shel yom beshel amesh. aval en mearvin niske chevasim beniske farim veelim. veim belalan ellu vifne atzman veellu vifne atzman, venitarvu, kesherin. im ad shello valal, pasul. hakkeves habba im haomer, af al pi shemminchato chefula, lo hayu nesachav kefulin:
9.5: Kol hammiddot shehayu vammikdash, hayu nigdashot, chutz mishshel kohen gadol, shehaya godshah letochah. middot hallach, berutzehen kodesh. umiddot hayyavesh, berutzehen chol. rabbi akiva omer, middot hallach kodesh, lefichach berutzehen kodesh. umiddot hayyavesh chol, lefichach berutzehen chol. rabbi yose omer, lo mishshum ze, ella shehallach nekar, vehayyavesh eno nekar:
9.6: Kol karbenot hatztzibbur vehayyachid teunin nesachim, chutz min habbechor vehammaaser vehappesach vehachattat vehaasham, ella shechattato shel metzora vaashamo teunim nesachim:
9.7: Kol karbenot hatztzibbur en bahem semicha, chutz min happar habba al kol hammitzvot, vesair hammishtalleach. rabbi shimon omer, af seire avoda zara. kol karbenot hayyachid teunim semicha, chutz min habbechor vehammaaser vehappasach. vehayyoresh somech umevi nesachim umemir:
9.8: Hakkol somchin, chutz mecheresh, shote, vekatan, suma, venachri, vehaeved, vehashshaliach, vehaishsha. usemicha, sheyare mitzva, al harosh, bishte yadayim. uvimkom shessomchin shochatin, vetechef lassemicha shechita:
9.9: Chomer bassemicha mibbattenufa uvattenufa mibbassemicha, sheechad menif lechol hachaverim veen echad somech lechol hachaverim. vechomer battenufa, shehattenufa noheget bekarbenot hayyachid uvekarbenot hatztzibbur, bachayyim uvashshechutin, bedavar sheyyesh bo ruach chayyim uvedavar sheen bo ruach chayyim, ma sheen ken bassemicha:

10.1: Rabbi yishmael omer, haomer haya va veshabbat mishshalosh sein, uvechol mechamesh. vachachamim omrim, echad beshabbat veechad bechol, mishshalosh haya va. rabbi chanina segan hakkohanim omer, beshabbat haya niktzar beyachid uvemaggal echad uvekuppa achat. uvechol, bishlosha uveshalosh kuppot uveshalosh maggalot. vachachamim omrim, echad beshabbat veechad bechol, bishlosha uveshalosh kuppot uveshalosh maggalot:
10.2: Mitzvat haomer lavo min hakkarov. lo vikker hakkarov lirushalayim, meviim oto mikkol makom. maase shebba miggaggot tzerifin, ushete hallechem mibbikat en socher:
10.3: Ketzad hayu osim. sheluche vet din yotzim meerev yom tov, veosim oto cherichot bimchubbar lakkarka, kede sheyyehe noach liktzor. vechol haayarot hassemuchot lesham, mitkannesot lesham, kede sheyyehe niktzar beesek gadol. kevan shechashecha, omer lahem, ba hashshamesh, omrim, hen. ba hashshamesh, omrim hen. maggal zo, omrim hen. maggal zo, omrim hen. kuppa zo, omrim hen. kuppa zo, omrim hen. beshabbat omer lahem, shabbat zo, omrim hen. shabbat zo, omrim hen. ektzor, vehem omrim lo ketzor. ektzor, vehem omrim lo ketzor. shalosh peamim al kol davar vedavar, vehem omrim lo hen, hen, hen. vechol kach lamma. mippene habbaytosim, shehayu omrim, en ketzirat haomer bemotzae yom tov:
10.4: Ketzaruhu unetanuhu vekuppot, heviuhu laazara, hayu mehavehvin oto vaur, kede lekayyem bo mitzvat kali, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, bekanim uviklichot chovtim oto, kede shello yitmaech. netanuhu laabbuv, veabbuv haya menukkav, kede sheyyehe haur sholet bechullo. shetachuhu vaazara, veharuach menashshevet bo. netanuhu verechayim shel garosot, vehotziu mimmennu issaron shehu menuppe mishshelosh esre nafa, vehashshear nifde veneechol lechol adam. vechayyav bachalla, ufatur min hammaasrot. rabbi akiva mechayyev bachalla uvammaasrot. va lo laissaron, venatan shamno ulevonato, yatzak, uvalal, henif, vehiggish, vekamatz, vehiktir, vehashshear neechol lakkohanim:
10.5: Mishshekkarav haomer, yotzin umotzin shuk yerushalayim shehu male kemach vekali, shello virtzon chachamim, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, birtzon chachamim hayu osim. mishshekkarav haomer, huttar hechadash miyyad, veharchokim muttarim mechatzot hayyom ulehallan. mishshecharav bet hammikdash, hitkin rabban yochanan ben zakkay, sheyyehe yom hanef kullo asur. amar rabbi yehuda, vahalo min hattora hu asur, shenneemar (Vayikra 23), ad etzem hayyom hazze. mippene ma harchokim muttarim mechatzot hayyom ulehallan, mippene shehen yodin sheen bet din mitatztzelin bo:
10.6: Haomer haya mattir bammedina, ushete hallechem bammikdash. en meviin menachot uvikkurim uminchat behema kodem laomer. veim hevi, pasul. kodem lishte hallechem, lo yavi. veim hevi, kasher:
10.7: Hachittim vehasseorim vehakkussemin veshibbolet shual vehashshifon chayyavin bachalla, umitztarfin ze im ze, vaasurim bechadash millifne happesach, umilliktzor millifne haomer. veim hishrishu kodem laomer, haomer mattiran. veim lav, asurim ad sheyyavo omer habba:
10.8: Kotzrim bet hashshelachim shebbaamakim, aval lo godshin. anshe yericho kotzrin birtzon chachamim, vegodshin shello virtzon chachamim, velo michu veyadam chachamim. kotzer lashshachat, umaachil labbehema. amar rabbi yehuda, ematay, bizman shehitchil ad shello hevia shelish. rabbi shimon omer, af yiktzor veyaachil af mishshehevia shelish:
10.9: Kotzrin mippene hannetiot, mippene vet haevel, mippene vittul bet hammidrash. lo yaase otan kerichot, aval mannichan tzevatim. mitzvat haomer lavo min hakkama. lo matza, yavi min hoomarim. mitzvato lavo min hallach. lo matza, yavi min hayyavesh. mitzvato liktzor ballayla. niktzar bayyom, kasher. vedoche et hashshabbat:

11.1: Shete hallechem nilloshot achat achat, veneefot achat achat. lechem happanim nillosh echad echad, veneefe shenayim shenayim. uvitfus haya ose otan. ucheshehu radan, notnan bitfus, kede shello yitkalkelu:
11.2: Echad shete hallechem veechad lechem happanim, lishatan vaarichatan bachutz, vaafiyyatan bifnim, veenan dochot et hashshabbat. rabbi yehuda omer, kol maasehem bifnim. rabbi shimon omer, leolam heve ragil lomar, shete hallechem velechem happanim kesherot baazara, uchesherot bevet pagi:
11.3: Chavitte chohen gadol, lishatan vaarichatan vaafiyyatan bifnim, vedochot et hashshabbat. tichunan veherkedan enan dochot et hashshabbat. kelal amar rabbi akiva, kol melacha sheefshar lah leasot meerev shabbat, ena docha et hashshabbat. veshei efshar lah leasot meerev shabbat, docha et hashshabbat:
11.4: Kol hammenachot yesh bahen maase cheli bifnim, veen bahen maase cheli vachutz. ketzad. shete hallechem arkan shiva verachban arbaa, vekarnotehen arba etzbaot. lechem happanim, arkan asara verachban chamishsha, vekarnotav sheva etzbaot. rabbi yehuda omer, shello tite, 15 22. ben zoma omer, venatatta al hashshulchan lechem panim lefanay tamid, sheyyehe lo fanim:
11.5: Hashshulchan, arko asara, verachbo chamishsha. lechem happanim, arkan asara verachban chamishsha. noten arko keneged rachbo shel shulchan, vechofel tefachayim umechetza mikkan utefachayim umechetza mikkan, nimtza arko memalle kol rachbo shel shulchan, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi meir omer, hashshulchan arko shenem asar verachbo shishsha. lechem happanim arko asara verachbo chamishsha. noten arko keneged rachbo shel shulchan, vechofel tefachayim mikkan utefachayim mikkan utefachayim revach baemtza, kede shettehe haruach menashshevet benehen. abba shaul omer, sham hayu notnin shene veziche levona shel lechem happanim. amru lo, vahalo chevar neemar (Vayikra kad), venatatta al hammaarechet levona zakka. amar lahen, vahalo chevar neemar (Bamidbar b), vealav matte menashshe:
11.6: Arbaa senifin shel zahav hayu sham, muftzalin merashehen, shehayu somchim bahen, shenayim leseder ze ushenayim leseder ze. veesrim ushemona kanim, kachatzi kane chalul, arbaa asar leseder ze vearbaa asar leseder ze. lo siddur kanim velo netilatan doche et hashshabbat, ella nichnas meerev shabbat veshomtan venotnan learko shel shulchan. kol hakkelim shehayu vammikdash, arkan learko shel bayit:
11.7: Shene shulchanot hayu vaulam mibbifnim al petach habbayit, echad shel shayish veechad shel zahav. al shel shayish notnim lechem happanim bichnisato, veal shel zahav bitziato, shemmaalin bakkodesh velo moridin. veechad shel zahav mibbifnim, shealav lechem happanim tamid. arbaa chohanim nichnasin, shenayim beyadam shene sedarim, ushenayim beyadam shene vezichim. vearbaa makdimin lifnehem, shenayim littol shene sedarim, ushenayim littol shene vezichim. hammachnisim omdim batztzafon, ufenehem laddarom. hammotziin omdim baddarom, ufenehem latztzafon. ellu moshchin veellu mannichin, vetifcho shel ze cheneged tifcho shel ze, shenneemar (Shemot 25), lefanay tamid. rabbi yose omer, afillu ellu notlin veellu mannichin, af zo hayta tamid. yatzu venatnu al hashshulchan shel zahav shehaya vaulam. hiktiru habbezichin, vehachallot mitchallekot lakkohanim. chal yom hakkippurim lihyot beshabbat, hachallot mitchallekot laarev. chal lihyot erev shabbat, sair shel yom hakkippurim neechol laarev, habbavliyyim ochlin oto keshehu chay, mippene sheddatan yafa:
11.8: Sidder et hallechem beshabbat veet habbezichim leachar shabbat vehiktir et habbezichim beshabbat, pesula, veen chayyavin alehen mishshum piggul, notar vetame. sidder et hallechem veet habbezichin beshabbat vehiktir et habbezichin leachar shabbat, pasul, veen chayyavin alehen mishshum piggul venotar vetame. sidder et hallechem veet habbezichin leachar shabbat vehiktir et habbezichin beshabbat, pasul. ketzad yaase. yannichenna lashshabbat habbaa, sheafillu hi al hashshulchan yamim rabbim, en bechach kelum:
11.9: Shete hallechem neechalot en pachot mishshenayim, velo yater al shelosha. ketzad. neefot meerev yom tov veneechalot beyom tov, lishnayim. chal yom tov lihyot achar hashshabbat, neechalot lishlosha. lechem happanim neechol en pachot mittisha, velo yater al achad asar. ketzad. neefe veerev shabbat veneechol beshabbat, letisha. chal yom tov lihyot erev shabbat, neechol laasara. shene yamim tovim shel rosh hashshana, neechol leachad asar. veeno doche lo et hashshabbat velo et yom tov. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer mishshum rabbi shimon ben hassegan, doche et yom tov veeno doche et yom tzom:

12.1: Hammenachot vehannesachim shennitmeu ad shello kiddeshan bakkeli, yesh lahen pidyon. mishshekkadshu vakkeli, en lahem pidyon. haofot vehaetzim vehallevona uchele sharet, en lahem pidyon, shello neemar ella behema:
12.2: Haomer, hare alay bemachavat, vehevi vemarcheshet, bemarcheshet vehevi vemachavat, ma shehevi hevi, vide chovato lo yatza. zo lehavi vemachavat, vehevi vemarcheshet, bemarcheshet, vehevi vemachavat, hare zo fesula. hare alay shene esronim lehavi vichli echad, vehevi vishne chelim, bishne chelim, vehevi vichli echad, ma shehevi hevi, vide chovato lo yatza. ellu lehavi vichli echad, vehevi vishne chelim, bishne chelim vehevi vichli echad, hare ellu fesulin. hare alay shene esronim lehavi vichli echad vehevi vishne chelim, amru lo bichli echad nadarta, hikrivan bichli echad, kesherim, uvishne chelim, pesulin. hare alay shene esronim lehavi vishne chelim, vehevi vichli echad, amru lo, bishne chelim nadarta, hikrivan bishne chelim, kesherim. netano vichli echad, kishte menachot shennitaravu:
12.3: Hare alay mincha min hasseorin, yavi min hachittim. kemach, yavi solet. belo shemen ulevona, yavi immah shemen ulevona. chatzi issaron, yavi issaron shalem. issaron umechetza, yavi shenayim. rabbi shimon poter, shello hitnaddev kederech hammitnaddevim:
12.4: Mitnaddev adam mincha shel shishshim issaron, umevi vichli echad. im amar hare alay shishshim veechad, mevi shishshim bichli echad veechad bichli echad, shekken tzibbur mevi veyom tov harishon shel chag shechal lihyot beshabbat shishshim veechad. dayyo layyachid sheyyehe fachot min hatztzibbur echad. amar rabbi shimon, vahalo ellu lapparim, veellu lakkevasim, veenam nivlalim ze im ze. ella, ad shishshim yecholim lehibbalel. amru lo, shishshim nivlalim, shishshim veechad en nivlalim. amar lahen, kol middot chachamim ken. bearbaim sea hu tovel, bearbaim sea chaser kurtov eno yachol litbol bahen. en mitnaddevim log, shenayim, vachamishsha, aval mitnaddevim shelosha vearbaa veshishsha, umishshishsha ulemala:
12.5: Mitnaddevim yayin, veen mitnaddevim shemen, divre rabbi akiva. rabbi tarfon omer, mitnaddevim shamen. amar rabbi tarfon, ma matzinu vayyayin shebba chova uva nedava, af hashshemen ba chova uva nedava. amar lo rabbi akiva, lo, im amarta vayyayin shekken hu karev chovato vifne atzmo, tomar bashshemen sheeno karev chovato vifne atzmo. en shenayim mitnaddevim issaron echad, aval mitnaddevim ola ushelamim. uvaof, afillu ferida echat:

13.1: Hare alay issaron, yavi echad. esronim, yavi shenayim. perashti veeni yodea ma perashti, yavi shishshim issaron. hare alay mincha, yavi ezo sheyyirtze. rabbi yehuda omer, yavi minchat hassolet, shehi meyuchedet shebbammenachot:
13.2: Mincha, min hammincha, yavi echat. menachot, min hammenachot, yavi shetayim. perashti veeni yodea ma perashti, yavi chamishtan. perashti mincha shel esronim veeni yodea ma perashti, yavi mincha shel shishshim issaron. rabbi omer, yavi menachot shel esronim meechad vead shishshim:
13.3: Hare alay etzim, lo yifchot mishshene gezirin. levona, lo yifchot mikkometz. chamishsha komatzim hen, haomer hare alay levona, lo yifchot mikkometz. hammitnaddev mincha, yavi immah kometz levona. hammaale et hakkometz bachutz, chayyav. ushene vezichin teunin shene komatzim:
13.4: Hare alay zahav, lo yifchot middinar zahav. kesef, lo yifchot middinar kasef. nechoshet, lo yifchot mimmaa chasef. perashti veeni yodea ma perashti, hu mevi ad sheyyomar lo lechach nitkavvanti:
13.5: Hare alay yayin, lo yifchot mishshelosha luggin. shemen, lo yifchot millog. rabbi omer, shelosha luggin. perashti veeni yodea ma perashti, yavi chayyom hammerubbe:
13.6: Hare alay ola, yavi cheves. rabbi elazar ben azarya omer, o tor o ven yona. perashti min habbakar veeni yodea ma perashti, yavi far vaegel. min habbehema veeni yodea ma perashti, yavi far vaegel ayil gedi vetale. perashti veeni yodea ma perashti, mosif alehem tor uven yona:
13.7: Hare alay toda, ushelamim, yavi cheves. perashti min habbakar veeni yodea ma perashti, yavi far ufara egel veegla. min habbehema veeni yodea ma perashti, yavi far ufara, egel veegla, ayil verachel, gedi ugediyya, sair useira, tale vetalya:
13.8: Hare alay shor, yavi hu unesachav bemane. egel, yavi hu unesachav bechamesh. ayil, yavi hu unesachav bishtayim. keves, yavi hu unesachav besala. shor bemane, yavi vemane chutz minnesachav. egel bechamesh, yavi vechamesh chutz minnesachav. ayil bishtayim, yavi vishtayim chutz minnesachav. keves besela, yavi vesela chutz minnesachav. shor bemane vehevi shenayim bemane, lo yatza, afillu ze vemane chaser dinar veze vemane chaser dinar. shachor vehevi lavan, lavan vehevi shachor, gadol vehevi katan, lo yatza. katan vehevi gadol, yatza. rabbi omer, lo yatza:
13.9: Shor ze ola, venistaev, im ratza, yavi vedamav shenayim. shene shevarim ellu ola, venistaavu, im ratza, yavi vidmehem echad. rabbi oser. ayil ze ola, venistaev, im ratza, yavi vedamav keves. keves ze ola venistaev, im ratza, yavi vedamav ayil. rabbi oser. haomer achad mikkevasay hekdesh, veachad mishshevaray hekdesh, hayu lo shenayim, haggadol shebbahen hekdesh. shelosha, habbenoni shebbahen hekdesh. perashti veeni yodea ma perashti, o sheamar, amar li abba veeni yodea ma, haggadol shebbahen hekdesh:
13.10: Hare alay ola, yakrivenna vammikdash. veim hikrivah bevet chonyo, lo yatza. sheakrivenna bevet chonyo, yakrivenna bammikdash. veim hikrivah bevet chonyo, yatza. rabbi shimon omer, en zo ola. hareni nazir, yegallach bammikdash. veim gillach bevet chonyo, lo yatza. sheagallach bevet chonyo, yegallach bammikdash. veim gillach bevet chonyo, yatza. rabbi shimon omer, en ze nazir. hakkohanim sheshshimmeshu bevet chonyo, lo yeshammeshu vammikdash birushalayim, veen tzarich lomar ledavar acher, shenneemar (Melachim b 23), ach lo yaalu kohane habbamot el mizbach Adonai birushalayim chi im achlu matztzot betoch achehem, hare hem kevaale mumin, cholkin veochlin, aval lo makrivin:
13.11: Neemar beolat habbehema ishshe reach nichoach (Vayikra 1), uveolat haof ishshe reach nichoach (sham), uvammincha ishshe reach nichoach (sham b), lelammed, sheechad hammarbe veechad hammamit, uvilvad sheyyechavven adam et dato lashshamayim:
